catalyst_rows.asset: Rose Bengal Sodium (RBS) via VisiRose / Bascom Palmer photodynamic antimicrobial therapy
catalyst_rows.indication: Infectious keratitis (bacterial, fungal, parasitic eye infections)
catalyst_rows.phase: Clinical stage (>500 patients across US, India, Brazil, Mexico)
catalyst_rows.raw_text: Dec 10-11, 2024: Provectus launched VisiRose Inc., a clinical-stage entity with University of Miami's Bascom Palmer Eye Institute, to commercialize Rose Bengal Photodynamic Antimicrobial Therapy (RB PDAT) for infectious keratitis. Therapy tested in 500+ patients with promising results vs. AMR pathogens.
